reviews.text: Everything was perfect!
A top choice for exotic pets. Excellent facilities, and our princesses only go to Vetex to be sure they are well cared for (and pampered).

Excellent clinic! I took my lovebird for a preventative check-up and he received excellent care.
A special thank you to Dr. Ana, who showed immense affection for my little one, explaining everything with patience and professionalism. I recommend them 100%!

We arrived with our Atlas heartbroken and left the clinic with our hearts full. Thanks to Dr. Vasco and the VetEx team, our Atlas received the care and support he needed to recover. From treatment to follow-up, VetEx was undoubtedly the best choice we made for our little warrior Atlas 🩶
We take our 3 guinea pigs to this veterinarian and are always well received. Dr. Vasco and Dr. Ana are very attentive and always take great care of our guinea pigs. Thank you!
Super friendly and very attentive to the animals, I highly recommend them!

Excellent service and knowledge.
I recommend them 100%.
Great doctors and very kind and patient. Always willing to help especially when its an urgency
Excellent experience. Top professionals.

Excellent staff
Great service
I recommend it

Excellent service.
The receptionist and the veterinarian were super attentive and polite. I took my ferret to be seen and they treated him very well.
I really liked the clinic, I've known Dr. Daniel for a long time. He's very kind and attentive to animals. Shiva loved the spa 🩵 thank you.

Terrible experience. I sought the services of this clinic because I noticed that my hamster was lethargic and urinating a very dark color.
The doctor's initial care wasn't bad. The rest was terrible. From paying for anesthesia that wasn't administered for an ultrasound.
They wouldn't let me watch the exam, now I know why...
A situation I had already experienced at another clinic with another hamster without any problems.
Because they didn't anesthetize the hamster, they cut its belly in several places while shearing it.
Supposedly they took blood for analysis, a situation that is very painful for them and, once again, done without anesthesia.
It came home with antibiotics and anti-inflammatories, and they never called me back to tell me the results of the ultrasound and the tests.
I called several times, until a month later they sent the results and I finally managed to speak to the veterinarian to explain them. However, the next day I already had the cost of the surgery in my email, if it didn't improve with the medication (380 euros).
I paid 400 euros for this terrible service.
I never went back there and I don't intend to go back again.

There is no place I trust more than VetEx! They have been an amazing support and service. Treatments, surgeries, check ups, etc all are done so carefully and with so much love ❤️ My bunny is the happiest because of them. VetEx will always have a special place in my heart.
They were the only ones to respond on a Friday late afternoon. Thank you very much for your kindness and professionalism.
There are no words to describe your affection for people and the care you have for animals. To this day, the best congratulations to all. 💙💙💙🙏🙏 …

Wonderful service, polite staff, and Dr. Daniel is a sweetheart, taking care of my 18 rabbits with care and dedication. Thank you so much to all the staff and veterinarians! Sebastian and Vivaldi are grateful 🥰 …
I give them a 1000 for service and attention. Very professional and kind. I recommend them.

I went to this clinic to have my rabbit spayed and I was very satisfied.
Unfortunately, I was coming from a rather complicated situation: I had already had the pre-operative consultation and scheduled the surgery date at another clinic, but shortly afterwards, they postponed the surgery date and, at the last minute, on the eve of the surgery, they canceled it due to internal problems, without giving me a new date for the surgery and without even mentioning the reimbursement of the pre-operative tests.
Then, I found Vetex; they dedicated more than an hour of their own time to the consultation to assess the rabbit's health, decide how to proceed and clarify all my doubts. It was the most meticulous consultation I have ever attended.
Even in the post-operative period, the clinic was always present, clarifying all doubts, even those sent by message at 9 pm, outside of business hours.
I loved the service provided by this clinic; Professionalism and support deserve a 10/10.
I will certainly continue to trust them and highly recommend them to everyone who cares about the health of their exotic animal, because they are true professionals and the animals are in good hands!
In addition, I saw that, for rabbits, they offer a grooming service and also collaborate with a pet hotel that I haven't tried yet, but it's definitely an important addition that I had never found in an exotic animal clinic. ❤️🌟

What can I say about this clinic and its professionals?
My little baby Pluquito (cockatiel) was really sick, and the care he received was spectacular.

The doctor, Ana Nassar, is an excellent professional who treated Pluquito very well and provided excellent care. The other doctor was also very helpful. And today he is doing well and is full of strength. Thank you 🙏
I am immensely grateful to the professionals; they are excellent and attentive.
Professional and highly attentive support, with immediate responses 24/7.
Always available, very professional and kind 😊 …
Excellent service, dedication and professionalism.
Super friendly and very good at what they do.
Excellent professionals, very competent, friendly and humane! I recommend them!
Wonderful, I have no words to express my gratitude ❤️🙏 …
Very good, great professionals 👏 …

My grandmother and I are very grateful for the humane, kind, and caring way all the members of the clinic treated our Bela...
Thank you all so much, from the bottom of our hearts!

Today, May 22, 2026, our Bambi🐇 was groomed, excellent work by Filipa Fernandes, as always very attentive, friendly and above all very professional... Our little one was always very calm and even fell asleep😍😴... which didn't happen last time... why??? Because they wouldn't let us in...
Today was spectacular, ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ service
Thank you Filipa and Dr. Rute Abreu! Our girl thanks you...❤️🐇🐰

One of the best veterinary clinics for exotic animals that exists, super friendly, attentive and very professional. I have a meerkat and I know he's in the best veterinary hands. I am very grateful for your service.
This would have been the 3rd time I've used Vetex for my Cockatiel,  (that bird gets into all kinds of trouble!) Each time, the team is always professional and kind. Appointments are very prompt.

Attentive service, highly competent professionals, and readily available services; we have several dwarf Russian hamsters, and one of them was in critical condition after being attacked. We expected the worst, but he had a spectacular recovery after treatment (despite being so tiny!).

A team that never lets me down! I highly recommend them 🥰
Super uncles of hazelnuts and acorns ❤️ …
Excellent team, always available both in person and via WhatsApp for any emergency outside of business hours.

My guinea pig, Chichas, was very well cared for in his last days and after his passing. I have been very well looked after by the team that looked after him.

Thank you very much.
Hugs.
Thank you for everything 😘

Excellent medical and support staff. Always available to answer all questions, very friendly and highly professional. My two guinea pigs have been followed for many months and have even undergone surgery, and I can only thank the entire team for their care, professionalism and dedication. I would particularly like to thank Dr. Daniel and Dr. Rute for all their availability and care.

I highly recommend them.

Having an exotic pet without specialized assistance is frustrating, worrying, and sometimes terrifying, especially when you live 100km from the capital. When we discovered VetEx, everything changed! Not only do they provide regular services in our city, but they also attended to our rabbit immediately in a very urgent situation that forced us to take her to Lisbon to save her. Always with professionalism, extensive technical knowledge, and deep respect for all species and the personality of each animal. The whole team is exemplary! They do remarkable work, with rare kindness and care. Thank you so much!
Dr. Rute is very professional and friendly. She explains in details and provides us with alternative treatments when needed. My rabbit likes her a lot.
Great friendliness and professionalism.
Amazing staff. They also have all the equipment to do tests on site. Thank you! 💕💕 …
They are very attentive and always available to help.
Best veterinary clinic experience ever, I highly recommend it ❤️
The veterinarians were very friendly and provided excellent service; you can tell they love animals.

I liked the clinic and the professionals; they provided guidance on the procedures (deworming) and documents in Portugal and made the passport for my cockatiel. I'll return in a few months for my bird's checkup.

Excellent healthcare professionals for exotic animals!
Immense knowledge, professionalism, competence, and friendliness from both the doctors and the staff.
We brought an injured pigeon here, they were incredibly helpful. I highly recommend

Without a doubt, they are the best. The level of care, affection, and treatment they give our furry friends is simply phenomenal.
There are no words to describe how much we trust the Vetex team.
Spectacular service, exemplary professionals. Super careful. They call and text to ask about my bunny, the sterilization went very well. I recommend them.

I was seen by my lovebird, Mango, and I only have good things to say. The veterinarian showed enormous care, a lot of patience, and genuine love for animals. He explained everything very clearly and calmly, and helped me understand exactly what was happening and how to act. I felt that my bird was in good hands from the very first moment.
The service was professional, attentive, and humane. I am very grateful for all the dedication and affection.
I recommend it 100%.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the VetEx clinic for the humane and caring way they treated my bunny, Candy.

After contacting 12 exotic animal clinics, they were the only ones within a 25km radius who accepted her, and that meant everything to us at such a difficult time.

Despite it being the first and only consultation at this clinic, and the outcome being the worst possible, I felt I was finally in a place where they truly cared about animal welfare.

I sincerely thank the veterinarian for his kindness, empathy, and professionalism, and the nurse, who was incredibly attentive.

Even though euthanasia was necessary, I felt my bunny was treated with the respect and affection she deserved until the very last second. Thank you ❤️‍🩹

We went to VetEx today and the service was simply FANTASTIC!!! 5-star service, they explained all the care we should take with our rabbit. Fantastic team. Congratulations!!! We became clients and we are much more relaxed because our rabbit will have all the necessary support to be healthy.
I recommend it 1000000%

There is no better veterinarian than Dr. Rute Abreu. Super professional, humane, she loves what she does, unlike other professionals in the field...
And with Filipa doing the grooming....well, what can I say? There's no better ❤️
Great team! More than 5-star service

An incredible service! The best veterinary experience I've ever had! Here, the veterinarian can be contacted via WhatsApp, making communication much easier. The staff at the veterinary center are very pleasant, doing everything to ensure that clients and animals are well.
Thank you so much VetEx for what you did 🙏🏻

This was my first experience with this clinic, and I was very pleased with the service and care provided. It's clear they have knowledge and experience with exotic birds, and they inspire confidence combined with friendliness, dedication, and availability. Given the difficulty in finding clinics with experience in exotic birds, I highly recommend VetEx.

Excellent service, friendliness, and quality of care provided. I can only recommend this clinic to anyone who wants to be well taken care of and satisfied with its excellent services.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank the entire team once again for the warm welcome we received, for your excellent professionalism, as well as for all the care given to our pet and the success of our canary Tweeny's operation, and for all the support provided. Thank you very much!

Best exotic pet clinic.
Excellent professionals, attentive, dedicated.
You can feel the love!

I place all my trust in Vetex to care for Speedy and Fluffy ❤️❤️

They treated my hamster urgently, and it was operated on right away.
Dr. Daniel and his assistant were very helpful and attentive.
Available, friendly, they explain everything in detail and with great care for our parties. Thank you Dr. Rute, Dr. Daniel and Filipa. Kisses to all. A truly top-notch team!

Although our first visit was during an emergency, we were well attended to and received from the start. Both the reception staff and the medical team treated us with the utmost professionalism and attention. We recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a professional to care for their pet.
Careful and attentive professionals. Tambor was very well treated, both clinically and during her grooming. Thank you!

I love it, thank you.
I recommend it, always well taken care of.....🫶🙏🙏🙏🙏🫶 …
Excellent doctors and staff, super dedicated and very friendly. Always available to answer any questions. I recommend them.
The service was exceptional. From communication to punctuality, friendliness, and professionalism, they handled the "beast" incredibly well. I highly recommend them.

I went with two rescued pigeons from the street and we were very well received. Dr. Rute was impeccable and very professional, both on the phone and in treating the boys.
I highly recommend VetEx to anyone who has exotic animals.
5*
Fantastic team 😍 They took great care of our little one! She's doing very well! Thank you for your service. …
Impeccable service. 5-star medical staff. I recommend them 100%.
Fantastic team! The care, attention, and professionalism are exceptional!
Exemplary professionals, both in terms of health and grooming. My rabbits have been cared for by this team for a long time. I recommend them 100%!
There are no words to describe this wonderful team! Without a doubt, the best!! I highly recommend them 😊 Kisses to all, Sara and Chloé 🥰 …
I definitely recommend the clinic. The service is professional, polite, and the contact line is very flexible. I will gladly return!

I had a truly exemplary experience at Vetex. A friend recommended them to take my rabbit, Kiki, and from the first phone call, I was treated with the utmost attention, professionalism, and kindness.

The service was extremely efficient; I was able to schedule an appointment from one day to the next, and they always demonstrated great availability and cordiality. On the day of the appointment, all clarifications were provided clearly and with careful attention to detail.

I highly recommend Vetex to anyone seeking an excellent veterinary service for exotic animals. Professionals of this caliber are undoubtedly increasingly rare these days.

My sincere congratulations to the entire team.

This was my first in-person visit, as I had already spoken to Dr. Daniel Castro on the phone to explain my parakeet's situation. I liked the service, both from the receptionist and the doctor. I recommend him!!

The love and care they show the animals, both during consultations and grooming, is incredible, and their complete availability to answer our questions and/or concerns guarantees that our animals are always well and happy 🐰 …

An amazing team! From the service, availability, knowledge and care for our little friends 🙂
They are a unique and incredible team! The best ever 🫶🏽❤️ …

VetEx is an incredible team, with true professionals, very experienced, dedicated and with enormous affection for animals.
We make a point of traveling several kilometers to them because, for us, it's unthinkable to put our bunny's health in other hands.
We know they will always do their best ✨
Excellent professionals from the start, we can finally say that we found good vets in what they do, Max and I thank them for all the care.

The best aunts and uncles for our babies is impossible to find!!

They are a very helpful team, clarifying all questions, even the smallest ones. They treat the babies like nephews and nieces, and you can see the love, care, and dedication they have for their work. They also know how to handle it when we get worried about our little ones' health!! I can say that we have never felt so safe with a veterinarian as we do with Vetex!!
A wonderful team

Extraordinary team. The only team that, after several attempts with other emergency veterinarians, provided an emergency consultation on a Sunday. In my experience, Dr. Daniel is excellent with land tortoises. I highly recommend them!

Miu Miu is a senior rabbit, but he had never been neutered. However, a tumor appeared in his testicles, which worried me a lot. I found the convenience of home visits at Vetex, and Dr. Daniel explained everything clearly, with the pros and cons. We did all the tests, and Dr. Daniel gave me complete confidence for the operation. Everything went well, and the recovery is going very well.
Thank you to the entire Vetex team and especially to Dr. Daniel.
Dr. Rute is an excellent professional in caring for our bunnies, Cookie and Kiko. She treats them with great love and dedication, but also with firmness and care. I recommend her 100%.

Friendliness and professionalism at the highest level.
My animals couldn't be in better hands.

Excellent service.
My 3 little ones (rabbits) were always going to the vet for emergencies, but since they've been followed by Vetex they've never had any more problems. Filipa's regular grooming is essential; after the grooming they become much more active and playful 😃 We love it and recommend it!

Excellent professionals, I can only thank you for all the care, dedication, professionalism and love for animals!
I have two girls 🐰🐰, one of them is in an emergency situation, she was seen by this wonderful team and she's doing great!
They have both been spayed by this team and they are fantastic! Just grateful!
Thank you so much to this whole team 🙏🏼❤️
Very competent and very caring with my little pig, spectacular, competent.

I want to express my deepest gratitude for the exceptional care I received from VetEx. The speed and efficiency of the service were remarkable, and I felt that Chloe was very well cared for from the very first moment. Dr. Rute was extremely attentive, always willing to answer my questions and keeping me informed with photos, phone calls, and messages. It's comforting to know that my Chloe was in such dedicated and caring hands. Thank you so much for all the care and professionalism!

Super helpful and friendly, their competence is unquestionable, I loved the visit! We talked about the health of my Ocadia Sinensis and the care it needs. Whenever I need it, I will continue to use VetEx's services. While other clinics with home visits only informed me of cost and availability, the vet, right from the first contact, was sensitive enough to ask for photos to assess the severity of the problem in order to validate whether it was an urgent matter, without gaining anything from this assessment. This availability demonstrates not only professionalism but also concern for animals. Thank you VetEx
Excellent service, professionalism, and friendliness. I am extremely happy and feel very confident about the future. Thank you and good work.
I had a great experience with the vet, everything went well.
Thank you to the entire Vetex team for all the care you have given my little one 🐰🐰 …

I have no words. Simply the best professionals who have ever treated my tortoise.
Excellent service, very attentive and concerned about my Coral, always available …

Spectacular and highly professional team, from health care and grooming to pet sitting. Always very friendly and ready to help in any way they can. For years I've only trusted my rabbit to the VetEx team!
Excellent, because in addition to the careful and affectionate way he treated the animals (in my case, 2 dwarf rabbits), he was top-notch in communicating with me as the owner. …

This team is wonderful, attentive, friendly, always available to answer any questions we may have, and above all, during consultations they are super caring and patient with the animals. I couldn't ask for a better "doctor" for my Ring Neck parrot.

The best exotic animal veterinarian! The VETEX team is very friendly and attentive. I had a home visit with my guinea pig, and it went super well! VETEX was always available to answer any questions via message or phone. They truly care about the animals and want to see their clients happy. I highly recommend them! ☺️

Without a doubt, the best veterinarians in the world! My guinea pigs and my turtle are regularly seen by Dr. Rute, and they couldn't be in better hands. It's the constant care and affection that makes all the difference in their treatment; …

I have two bunnies 🐰🐰 and, about two years ago, in an emergency situation, I found this wonderful team. Since then, they have been tireless: professional, attentive, caring, and extremely dedicated. 🥇 …
Tobias couldn't be happier with his vet, Dr. Daniel Castro. He's always spoiled by everyone when he goes to his appointments. Kisses and thanks to the whole team! 🐰 …

Excellent service.
The consultation was very detailed; the veterinarian demonstrated expertise and genuine interest in the animal. They provide advice at all levels, including after the consultation, with very useful informative documents. I recommend them ✨️
